A method that uses a deformation MLP to model non-rigid scenes.

Subsequent methods like [MoCo-NeRF](16197-moco-nerf.md) and [SelfNeRF](18160-selfnerf.md) refined this by decoupling rigid and non-rigid components or leveraging surface geometry for faster convergence.
